items.title: Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP - GoDaddy Inc. (GDDY) Investors: October 20, 2026, Deadline in Securities Fraud Class Action Lawsuit
items.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against GoDaddy Inc. for allegedly making materially false statements about its go-to-market strategy. The company failed to disclose a promotional discount for dotcom domains that resulted in shorter-term, lower-value contracts, causing bookings growth to miss guidance. GoDaddy's stock fell over 14% on February 24, 2026, when the company revealed the fourth quarter bookings growth declined to 5%. Investors who purchased GDDY stock between September 3, 2025, and February 24, 2026, can seek lead plaintiff status by October 20, 2026.

items.title: Zacks Industry Outlook GoDaddy, Vipshop, MakeMyTrip and QuinStreet
items.summary: The Zacks Internet-Delivery Services industry, including GoDaddy, Vipshop Holdings, MakeMyTrip, and QuinStreet, is positioned for growth driven by smartphone penetration, emerging market expansion, and shifting consumer preferences toward online services. However, the industry faces headwinds from macroeconomic uncertainties, inflation, high interest rates, tariffs, and geopolitical tensions. The industry trades at a valuation discount (0.88X P/S) compared to the broader market and has underperformed the S&P 500 by 31.6% over the past year, though it ranks in the top 19% of Zacks industries.

items.title: Kaplan Fox Encourages GoDaddy Inc. (NYSE: GDDY) Investors with Significant Losses to Contact the Firm Before October 20, 2026
items.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed a class action lawsuit against GoDaddy Inc. alleging the company made false and misleading statements about its customer growth strategy during September 2025 through February 2026. The company allegedly implemented promotional discounts on short-term contracts that caused bookings growth to decelerate to 5% in Q4 2025, which was not disclosed to investors. The stock price fell 14% (from $92.30 to $79.12 per share) on February 25, 2026 following the disclosure of the true financial results.
